messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy initiated — environment: devtest, tag: v1.4.7-alpha2, commit: 9f8a7b6, initiated by @alex_cheng

alex_cheng: kicking off smoke and watching svc-ingest primarily. will report if anything looks off.

deploy-bot: step: rolling update svc-ingest (3 pods) -> 1/3 updated. image: registry/redwood/service-ingest:9f8a7b6

maria_g: seeing a brief run of 502s from svc-ingest during the first pod restart :thinking_face: — looks like the old pod still returning 502s for a few seconds

jamal: tailing logs now, seeing a short spike of connection resets on worker threads during startup. nothing fatal in traces yet.

sre-oncall: metrics: svc-ingest 5xx rate +3.5% and p50 latency +30ms coinciding with 1st pod rollout. not systemic but visible.

alex_cheng: ok let's not roll the remaining pods for svc-ingest. plan: pin svc-ingest to previous image (9a1b2c3) and continue with other services. keeps the rest of the deploy moving.

deploy-bot: executing pin: svc-ingest -> image registry/redwood/service-ingest:9a1b2c3 (previous stable). applying patch to deployment to rollback image for svc-ingest only.

paula: re-running smoke specifically against svc-ingest endpoints /ingest and /health. will report results in ~30s.

deploy-bot: smoke check: svc-ingest /health -> 200 OK, /ingest -> 202 Accepted. all other service rollouts completed successfully.

alex_cheng: deploy finished with a partial pin on svc-ingest. duration ~65s. created follow-up issue to investigate startup connection handling on new image.

maria_g: noted — scheduling extended canary for svc-ingest next devtest window with additional startup tracing.

jamal: thumbs up. @sre-oncall can you add the relevant metric alert for next run?

sre-oncall: will add a temporary alert on pct5xx and startup latency for the canary.

paula: thanks all — moving this change toward sandbox tomorrow during the change window at 10:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:
